heroTitle: Send Meta only the conversions that matter.
heroDescription: Confirma sits between your store and Meta. Only confirmed orders become conversion events — so your ad optimization reflects real purchases, not abandoned checkouts.

setupSteps.storeDescription: Link Shopify, WooCommerce, or YouCan to receive orders.
setupSteps.metaDescription: Add your Meta Pixel and Conversions API credentials.
setupSteps.confirmationDescription: Define how orders are confirmed before conversions are sent.
